name: Dr. Mario™: Miracle Cure
description:
If you’re itching for puzzle fun, we’ve
got the perfect prescription – Dr.
Mario: Miracle Cure, only for
Nintendo 3DS family systems! Both
Dr. Mario and Dr. Luigi are on call to
deal with an outbreak of troublesome
viruses in loads of modes filled with
classic Dr. Mario mayhem. When
viruses strike, matching colours is the
only remedy!
disclaimer:
You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.

Broadband Internet access required for online features. Learn more at support.nintendo.com.
descriptors: Online Interactions Not Rated by the ESRB
